newsitem.title: USA: U.S. to sell $23 billion of 3-, 6-mo bills Sept 23.
newsitem.headline: U.S. to sell $23 billion of 3-, 6-mo bills Sept 23.

text.p: The Treasury Department said on Tuesday it will auction $23 billion of three- and six-month bills on Sept 23 to pay down $3.65 billion as $26.656 billion of bills are maturing.
The weekly bill sale will be equally divided between the two maturities. The bills will be issued Sept 26. The three-month bills mature December 26 and the six-month bills mature March 27, 1997.
The CUSIP number for the three-month bills is 9127943T9 and for the six-month bills is 9127944D3.
